decision: Do not add a purportedly sound speculative frontend from the available aggregate reports and committed-PC callbacks. A narrow sequential-block prototype is possible only with explicit additional inputs and scheduler separation described below.
current_observation_limits: Observer before(pc,bits) / after(next_pc,committed) contains architectural instruction information, not actual frontend request, predicted-PC, squash, I-cache refill or fetch queue events.
Retained per-window reports provide feature aggregates and identities, not per-PC instruction/fill-ready timelines. The selected ELF supplies static bytes but not speculative execution history.
A future committed PC is not proof the frontend predicted or fetched it before branch resolution. Feeding the committed trace ahead across branches would silently assume perfect prediction.

Engine.submit_detached restores the CPU frontier after an event, but event submission still starts at max(event.earliest,current issue_frontier). It cannot insert a frontend request earlier than a fence barrier already processed by the online observer.

The shared mutable cache/line-dependency state also advances in observation order; scheduling earlier fetches after later CPU/device accesses would violate event/cache ordering even if a timestamp were backdated.
minimal_sequential_only_prototype_requir: Immutable exact ELF/code map and instruction byte lengths; bounded buffered straight-line blocks. Any branch/jump/return, exception, self-modifying code or fence.i ends the predictable block unless an explicit source-bound policy supplies its behavior.

Selected hardware fetch packet width, pipeline stages, queue entry count, partial-instruction behavior, stall/redirect/kill rules and refill handshake. Queue entries must represent fetch packets, not assume one instruction per entry; compressed instruction boundaries matter.

Separate monotonic frontend and backend issue frontiers with globally consistent memory-event ordering; line-fill completion tokens feed queued decode entries. Backend fence drains appropriate resources while frontend runs only as permitted by selected RTL.

No invented wrong-path PCs. Speculative predecessor history or BTB/BHT/RAS state not supplied by a validated model is explicitly unknown. A sequential-only estimate cannot claim complete timing for the current branching diagnostic.

Before/after model prediction comparisons retain original prices, target provider and exact scope pins; any structural changes informed by these failed validation labels make this family development data.

software_side: counter boundaries and actual register-resolved command operands
per-PC modeled fetch line state, request issue, fill-ready and consumer issue
target command admission/ready and fence start/completion
hardware_side_if_available: I-cache miss/refill request and completion with line identity
backend fence stall/completion and selected counter reads
smallest_additional_trace_contract.privacy: Only public diagnostic data. No private reference code, schedules, labels or evaluator coefficients become author inputs.

smallest_public_discriminator_design.question: Can the selected frontend bring a known sequential instruction line into flight while backend waits for an already-issued accelerator operation?
smallest_public_discriminator_design.source: Public raw ISA, one independently checked full-tile resident operation; explicit32-bit straight-line instructions in bounded measurement blocks; no loop/branch inside the block.
smallest_public_discriminator_design.variants: Two code layouts with identical semantic work, instruction count and fence semantics: a new code-line crossing within the selected fetch queue reach of a blocking ordinary fence versus beyond that bounded reach. Predeclared first-use and exact prewarmed occurrences; label history explicitly rather than asserting coldness.
smallest_public_discriminator_design.controls: Exact output/guard checking outside windows, fixed input/data addresses, source/ELF/layout pins; fixed launch/completion/CSR boundaries; preserve any out-of-window warmup and optional explicit fence.i as separate declared treatments.
smallest_public_discriminator_design.interpretation: Need per-line frontend/refill observations or a sufficiently discriminating paired result to assess the structural mechanism. A changed total alone does not identify miss latency or justify adjusting queue prices.
smallest_public_discriminator_design.authorization: No execution from this design; new source/scopes, support review, frozen criteria and explicit physical authorization required.

qualification: Existing model remains provisional and denied for broader qualification; no changed coefficient, favorable fallback or discarded failed criterion.
